premises.text: The internet has evolved to become fragmented and difficult to navigate
premises.evidence_span: the rapid growth of the web scattered content across millions of websites, forcing us to jump site-to-site, assembling bits and pieces of information

premises.text: Current web browsing leads to a fragmented experience with multiple tabs and apps
premises.evidence_span: We've traded the fluidity and connectedness of surfing for stacks of browser tabs and single-purpose mobile apps

premises.text: VIRB can weave together services to create a seamless browsing experience
premises.evidence_span: to reinvent surfing the internet on web or mobile by weaving together services you use

premises.text: VIRB organizes user activity into a continuous stream without needing to open new tabs
premises.evidence_span: VIRB automatically organizes my activity into a stream that stays with me

premises.text: VIRB allows users to save and share their activity streams
premises.evidence_span: I can save this entire activity stream into a collection, which I can share publicly or in this case with just my team

premises.text: VIRB syncs user activity and data across devices
premises.evidence_span: VIRB syncs my activity and data across devices

premises.text: VIRB integrates with other apps to provide comprehensive information
premises.evidence_span: VIRB even deep links right into other apps on my phone, like Yelp, Foursquare, OpenTable, and Google Maps

premises.text: VIRB uses data technologies like semantic search and recommendations to build contextual bridges
premises.evidence_span: To build these contextual bridges across services, we use data technologies like semantic search and recommendations

premises.text: VIRB aims to bring back the magic of surfing the web
premises.evidence_span: we can finally bring back the magic of surfing, fluidly moving from link to link, service-to-service on any screen or device

value.text: VIRB provides a seamless and integrated browsing experience
value.evidence_span: the next evolution of search, browsing, and sharing

notes: No traction metrics or external partnerships were coded.
